raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, pistols and related parts should re-verify ECCN classification (including any shift back toward EAR99 or 0A/0B controls), confirm license exception eligibility, and update internal compliance programs. US HTS alignment, Section 301 tariff exposure, and BIS Entity List screening remain mandatory before shipment. Reassess end-user/end-use statements and destination-based restrictions, since some destinations may still require licenses.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的民用枪械出口规则，放宽了《出口管理条例》下民用枪械及弹药的许可与分类处理。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪、手枪及相关零部件的企业应重新核实ECCN分类（包括是否回归EAR99或0A/0B管制），确认许可例外适用性，并更新内部合规计划。发运前仍须完成美国HTS归类对齐、301条款关税风险排查及BIS实体清单筛查。同时应重新评估最终用户/最终用途声明及目的地限制，部分目的地可能仍需许可证。

checklist.desc: Re-classify civilian firearms, ammunition and parts under the revised EAR treatment; confirm whether items move to EAR99 or remain under 0A/0B controls and document the basis.
Assess whether the rescission restores eligibility for license exceptions (e.g., LVS, TSR where applicable) and record the determination for each product line.
Map each firearm/part to the correct 10-digit HTS line, check Section 301 list exposure and additional duties, and document country of origin and value build-up.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Run restricted party, Entity List and end-user screening for all consignees; retain end-use statements and destination-based license determinations.
Revise the internal compliance program, retrain staff on the rescinded rule, and retain classification, licensing and screening records for the EAR five-year retention period.
